work_order.understanding: The one review finding from PR #61 still holds on main (HEAD 6c7bda0): app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:547-548 carries a two-line JSX comment between the transfer <li> (opens :543) and its outer name <span> (:549). It explains min-w-0 on the name span and also describes ml-auto on the amount span, which sits further down at :564-566, not at this position. Repo guidance is one short line, and app/groups/[id]/transfer-line-wrap.test.ts (header, lines 8-11) already explains both min-w-0 and ml-auto. This is a comment-only trim; rendered markup is unchanged. The previous plan was rejected because its criteria were verify:test while tests[] was empty and no CI case proved the comment; this version adds that case.
work_order.approach: 1) In page.tsx replace lines 547-548 with the single line {/* min-w-0: overflow-wrap cannot lower a flex item's min-content floor. */} at the same indentation; the markup beneath is untouched. The new line must not contain the literal strings '<span', '{transferWords(' or 'data-amount', which transfer-line-wrap.test.ts and amounts-tabular.test.ts locate by indexOf/lastIndexOf; the text contains none. 2) Add one case to the existing describe in transfer-line-wrap.test.ts, named 'keeps the comment above the name wrapper to one line about min-w-0 and not the amount's ml-auto': source = pageSource(); li = source.lastIndexOf('<li', source.indexOf(CALL)) (the nearest <li before the single transfer-words call, i.e. the transfer row); outer = source.indexOf('<span', li) (the outer name wrapper); start = source.indexOf('{/*', li); end = source.indexOf('*/}', start); assert start and end are >= 0 and both < outer (the comment sits between the <li> and the name wrapper, not a later one); comment = source.slice(start, end); assert it contains 'min-w-0', does not contain '\n' (single line) and does not contain 'ml-auto'. The anchors reuse the file's CALL constant and pageSource() helper. The test's wording lives only in the test file, never in page.tsx. The case fails on main (two lines, names ml-auto) and passes after the trim, so it is a genuine red-to-green proof. Do not touch the other multi-line JSX comments in this block (:538-541, :555-556): the issue names only :547 and they carry an ADR-linked rationale. Do not edit amounts-tabular.test.ts; it is only run.

issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #61 (for #60) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### The added JSX comment is two lines and also describes the amount span from a position above the name span; the repo's guidance is one short line, and the test header already carries the same explanation.

> The added JSX comment is two lines and also describes the amount span from a position above the name span; the repo's guidance is one short line, and the test header already carries the same explanation.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:547`
> 
> Evidence: gh pr diff 61 adds a two-line {/* min-w-0: ... ml-auto on the amount ... */} block between the li and the outer span.
> 
> Fix: Trim to one line ("min-w-0: overflow-wrap cannot lower a flex item's min-content floor.") or drop it in favour of the test header.
